title: "Activity 5 - Database project brainstorming"
subtitle: "Choose a topic together and describe the database you want to build"

Work with your project group to compare two or three database ideas and **choose one during the first 25 minutes**. Use the remainder of class to describe its purpose, users, potential entities and relationships, and open modeling questions. The worksheet provides guidance and space for your answers.
